nodes.description: Public token name string, immutable after deployment initialization.
Public token symbol string.
Public decimals value (18).
Mapping address => uint256 public balance ledger; mutated by IHate0xBTC, transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping owner => spender => uint256 approval ledger; read in transferFrom and written in approve/transferFrom.
Mapping uint hash => bool marking already-claimed hate reasons; used as the mining/collision guard.
Public total supply counter; incremented in IHate0xBTC without a checked-supply invariant.
Public mining/mint entry point: hashes a user-supplied reason string, mints 10**18 tokens to msg.sender on a new hash and bumps totalSupply.
Public token transfer guarded by validAddress modifier; moves _value from msg.sender to _to.
Public delegated transfer guarded by validAddress modifier; consumes allowance[_from][msg.sender].
Public approval setter guarded by validAddress modifier; enforces zero-front-running rule.
Modifier asserting msg.sender is not the zero address; applied to transfer, transferFrom and approve.
Caller-controlled address; used as mint recipient in IHate0xBTC and as the balance/allowance owner elsewhere.
totalSupply += (10 ** 18) unchecked arithmetic inside IHate0xBTC; no overflow guard despite the comment.
balanceOf[msg.sender] += (10 ** 18) unchecked mint arithmetic inside IHate0xBTC.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value unchecked subtraction in transfer after a require pre-check.
balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked addition in transfer.
balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked addition in transferFrom.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked allowance decrement in transferFrom.
User-supplied hate reason string; keccak256-hashed to derive the mining key.
Recipient address for transfer and transferFrom.
Amount to move or approve; feeds the unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic.
Source address whose balance and allowance are debited in transferFrom.
Spender address granted an allowance in approve.
Hashed reason key used to index ZEROxBTCHaters.
Loop counter for the 100-iteration emit Transfer loop in IHate0xBTC.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the mint recipient inside IHate0xBTC.
msg.sender is the debited owner in transfer.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
The validAddress modifier asserts on msg.sender to gate function entry.
reason string is the input argument of IHate0xBTC.
reason is hashed into the local hash key.
hash indexes the ZEROxBTCHaters difficulty/collision map.
_from selects the balance/allowance slot debited in transferFrom.
_spender is the allowance beneficiary in approve.
_to is the credited recipient in transfer.
_to is the credited recipient in transferFrom.
_value is the amount moved by transfer.
_value is the amount moved by transferFrom.
_value is the allowance amount set by approve.
_value is subtracted from the sender balance without SafeMath.
_value is added to the recipient balance without SafeMath.
_value is added to the recipient balance in transferFrom without SafeMath.
_value is subtracted from the source balance without SafeMath.
_value is subtracted from the allowance without SafeMath.
IHate0xBTC mints 10**18 into balanceOf with unchecked addition.
IHate0xBTC increases totalSupply with unchecked addition.
The already-claimed hash check branches and writes ZEROxBTCHaters[hash] = true.
IHate0xBTC writes the balanceOf ledger.
IHate0xBTC mutates the totalSupply counter.
Loop counter i drives the 100-iteration emit loop in IHate0xBTC.
transfer is executed under the validAddress modifier check.
transferFrom is executed under the validAddress modifier check.
approve is executed under the validAddress modifier check.
transfer performs the unchecked sender balance decrement.
transfer performs the unchecked recipient balance increment.
transfer writes balanceOf entries for sender and recipient.
transferFrom performs the unchecked recipient balance increment.
transferFrom performs the unchecked source balance decrement.
transferFrom performs the unchecked allowance decrement.
transferFrom writes balanceOf entries for source and recipient.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance ledger.
approve writes the allowance ledger for msg.sender and _spender.

normalization_plan.reason: The reason parameter is only meaningful as the input of IHate0xBTC and should be folded into that core function node.
The _to recipient parameter is a temporary carrier for the transfer destination balance update.
The _value amount parameter is a temporary carrier for the unchecked balance arithmetic in transfer.
The _from parameter only selects the balance/allowance slots touched by transferFrom.
The _spender parameter only selects the allowance slot written by approve.
The local hash is an intermediate keccak256 key computed and consumed entirely inside IHate0xBTC.
The loop counter i is a purely local iteration variable of the IHate0xBTC emit loop.
